messages:
Avery (CEO): Morning — quick Q1 wrap + priorities for next 7 days. High level: we grew MRR ~18% MoM, NPS sits at 62, and infra availability for hosted API was 99.95% for the quarter. Thanks to everyone who shipped Dedicated autoscaler improvements — they mattered on Thursday's load test.

Avery (CEO): What I want us focused on: 1) EU Dedicated GA launch next Wed (sales enablement + runbook), 2) finish the Default Data Retention policy rollout for hosted accounts, 3) close top 1–2 enterprise opportunities (enablement tasks below), 4) reduce median 99th-pct latency for chat from 320ms -> 270ms.

Avery (CEO): Policy change note: hosted request/trace logs retention default moves from 90 -> 30 days for free/self-serve tiers to reduce cost and simplify compliance. Enterprise tiers keep customizable retention. This rolls out as a soft default next Tue; we'll email affected accounts and surface the change in Console. @Sofia please confirm KMS/HSM details for Enterprise.

Maya (VP Product): For EU GA: feature flags will gate burst capacity and KV cache prewarm. Prod rollout plan in the doc: http://intranet.redwood/release/eu-dedicated-ga — can teams review canary targets by EOD Monday?

Ravi (VP Eng): Noted on latency target. Eng plan: 1) re-tune kernel selection for common seq lengths, 2) increase aggressive prefix caching for chat routes, 3) add an infra metric to detect KV cache churn. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow. @ops-oncall please attach the Tuesday incident RCA to that invite.

Sofia (Security): Data retention change is approved. Enterprise KMS/HSM integrations remain unchanged. Timeline: KMS docs updated by Mon, opt-in migration tooling by end of Q2. We will send a compliance FAQ to sales.

Li (Head of Sales): EU Dedicated GA is huge — we have a Fortune 500 pilot asking for region-level SLA and on-prem packaging options. Can we prioritize the runbook and pricing sheet? Sales needs an answer by Tue.

Avery (CEO): Li — assign the deal owner and cc @Maya and @Ravi; we’ll slot a 30-min alignment with Solutions tomorrow.

ops-oncall: quick incident log (Tue 03:14): spike in autoscaler decision loop caused a short degraded window (~12m) for hosted-chat in us-east-1. Root cause: race in capacity delta computation when many warm nodes returned null current_load -> fallback to conservative decisions. Mitigations: rollback greedy autoscale gate, patch rolling out now.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T09:02 UTC — patch autoscaler-v2.1.3 -> applied to canary, 3/3 canary nodes healthy, rolling to remainder.

Ravi (VP Eng): Thanks ops-oncall. We see the patch dropping the error rate to baseline in canary. Full rollout target today. Post-mortem scheduled Fri 10:00. Action: add unit test for capacity delta null handling.

Nia (People Ops): Quick people note — hiring: we approved two senior infra ICs and one product manager for Dedicated. Expect requisitions to be posted next week. Also, Town Hall this Friday at 16:00 PT — Avery will present the Q1 numbers + roadmap highlights.

Maya (VP Product): One ask: product will freeze non-blocking UI changes for Console on Wed to avoid interrupts during EU GA. Notify integrators.

Sofia (Security): Small roll: compliance requirements for EU data residency added to the onboarding checklist. @Li I'll send a short email template for prospects.

Li (Head of Sales): :raised_hands: thanks team. I'll circulate the prospect's requirements and schedule the alignment.

Avery (CEO): Closing ask — each leadership area please add 1–2 measurable goals in the Q1->Q2 transition doc by EOD Monday (sales: $TAM plays, eng: latency SLOs/tech debt slices, product: key GA deliverables). Link: http://intranet.redwood/exec/q1-q2-transition. Short sync Monday morning if needed.

Ravi (VP Eng): Will do.

Maya (VP Product): Will do.

Sofia (Security): Will do.

Avery (CEO): Great work team. Quick wins this week will make the GA and policy rollouts smooth — focus on the runbooks and communication. :rocket:
